data.title: 灰姑娘 · 擦掉最后一圈水痕
data.description: 水晶镜廊的清晨还很安静。灰姑娘坐在窗旁，把缎面外袍的腰带系好，抬起一面小手镜。她捏着软布顺玻璃边缘慢慢擦过，最后才把手镜轻轻转向窗光检查水痕。
data.action: 一手握住小手镜，另一手沿玻璃边缘用布擦掉水痕。
data.promptProse: In the quiet mirror gallery she sits at a small table with her matching satin robe wrapped and tied over the mist-blue nightdress. She wipes a water mark from the edge of a small hand mirror, then tilts the glass toward the window to check her work. The frame follows her hands and face from across the table.
data.animaCaption: Her outer robe is wrapped and tied as she tips the polished mirror toward the window.
